uncompress_strand: uncompress a flattened strand point cloud using strand separation values into individual strand lists
strands_kdtree_query: query a KDTree for nearest neighbor points in a target point cloud given input points
densify_pc: densify a point cloud by duplicating points based on a per-point density map
compute_len_loss: compute the length consistency loss between two sets of strands using L1 or L2 distance
compute_len2_loss: compute the second-order length loss between two strand sets with L1, L2, or max threshold modes
compute_tangential_loss: compute the tangential displacement loss between two strand sets to penalize non-tangential movement
StrandsOptimizerNeuralCubic: create a StrandsOptimizerNeuralCubic instance to optimize hair strand control points against a target point cloud
StrandsOptimizerNeuralCubic_filtering_st: filter input strands by removing outliers that are too far from the target point cloud
StrandsOptimizerNeuralCubic_diff_spline: evaluate a natural cubic spline on strand control points to produce smooth splined points
StrandsOptimizerNeuralCubic_optimization: run the strand optimization loop to fit control points to a target point cloud using chamfer and regularization losses
